_about: Frank's deal tracker step library. 'core' steps go on every deal; each add-on switches on only when the deal needs it. rel = [base date, days]: base is accepted, close or insp (end of inspection period). Words in {first}, {title}, {price} fill in from the deal.

core.what: The sellers accepted your offer. This page shows every step from here to keys in your hand.
{title} handles the title search and the closing. I'll add the closer's name and contact info here.

core.t: Earnest money delivered to Sine & Monaghan
core.what: Check made out to Sine & Monaghan. I'll get it deposited into the escrow account and send the listing agent proof of the deposit. It's credited toward your purchase at closing.
Unless you have an inspector you prefer, I'll recommend one, schedule it and meet them there.
Once we have the inspection report, we decide together: move forward, ask for repairs or a credit, or walk away. I send our response before the deadline.
The title company confirms clear ownership. I look it over and flag anything unusual.
Ask your insurance agent for a policy starting on the closing day and send the declarations page to the title company.

core.t: Utilities set up in your name
core.what: Electric (DTE), gas, internet and cable starting the day you get the keys.

core.t: Closing statement and funds to title
core.what: The title company sends the final closing numbers. Before wiring anything, call the title company at a number you already know to confirm the wiring instructions. Never use wiring instructions sent by email alone.
We check that the home is as agreed, right before closing. It's your choice whether to do it.
Place and time to be set with the title company.
Possession at closing, so the keys are yours that day.

core.t: Brokermint: rename the file to the address; upload the signed purchase agreement, buyer agency agreement and escrow deposit receipt; add the title contact
Closing Board entry and goal tracker updated
Send the listing agent proof of the earnest money deposit

core.what: Copy the last request exactly with this deal's info.

core.t: After closing: thank-you card, review request, new address in Outlook and Follow Up Boss, anniversary saved

addons.label: Financing
addons.desc: Loan application, appraisal, mortgage commitment, Closing Disclosure

steps.t: Mortgage application submitted to the lender
steps.what: Apply with your lender and send them the signed purchase agreement. I'll make sure they have everything from our side.
The lender orders the appraisal. I meet the appraiser and share the comps that support the price.
The lender's written approval of your loan. Once it's in, the financing contingency is satisfied.

steps.t: Closing Disclosure received (3 days before closing)
steps.what: Your lender sends the final loan numbers at least 3 business days before closing. Look it over and ask me anything.

addons.label: Condo
addons.desc: Condo documents, review period, HO-6, association rules

steps.t: Condo documents delivered by the seller
steps.what: Master deed, bylaws, rules, budget and association details. I forward everything to you as soon as it arrives.
You have a set number of days after delivery to read the documents. Let me know of any questions before this date.

steps.t: Check the association's pet and move-in rules
steps.what: Noting any pet, move-in, parking or transfer-fee rules.
Ask your insurance agent for a condo HO-6 policy starting on the closing day.

addons.label: Sale of buyer's home
addons.desc: Your current home has to sell first

steps.t: Your current home listed for sale
steps.what: Your purchase depends on selling your current home, so we get it on the market right away.

steps.t: Offer accepted on your current home
steps.what: Once it's under contract, I let the sellers here know.
Usually the same day or just before this closing.

addons.label: Sellers stay after closing
addons.desc: Seller occupancy, escrow held, move-out and keys

steps.what: Money is held from the sellers' proceeds until they move out and hand over the keys.

steps.t: Sellers move out and hand over the keys
steps.what: I confirm the move-out date with the listing agent.
We check the home after they leave; then the escrow is released.
Spells out the move-in date, insurance and any daily charge before closing.

addons.label: City C of O / city inspection

steps.what: The City's required inspection. The title company needs it passed before closing. I'll let you know what the City finds.
Anything the City requires gets fixed before closing or money is held to cover it.

steps.t: Lead-based paint disclosure and pamphlet signed
steps.what: Required for homes built before 1978. Signed with the offer.

addons.label: Repairs or credit from inspection
addons.desc: Repair agreement and proof the work was done

steps.what: What the sellers agreed to fix or credit, in writing.
I get the receipts and we check the work at the walk-through.
Covers major systems and appliances for the first year.
Confirms the lot lines and that nothing crosses them.
I look it over and flag anything unusual.
